label: PAPER initial bank. Not a deposit and not a live authorization.
bankNote: Six percent of this paper bank is a 12 dollar ceiling, not an order target.
cashNote: Free cash and locked capital must both be entered and must add up to the paper bank. Neither is assumed.
profitNote: A fresh paper journal is logical profit 0 and is not a real-money claim. Do not type a profit here.
feeNote: Displayed fomo.family buy and sell quotes are required. maxFeeRate and maxFeeScope stay null, so suggestions stay blocked. The 0.24 dollar low-route scenario at the 12 dollar ceiling is not a quote. The user guard at that size is 0.95 dollars and is not the venue schedule.
